name: AdGuard Home DNS Detection
name_zh: AdGuard Home DNS 偵測套組
summary: Grades AdGuard Home blocks by list (threat, filter bypass, dynamic DNS, rebinding, abused TLDs, new domains, ads), reports the first lookup of a threat or bypass domain by each client, optionally grades allowed queries (OAST callbacks, mining pools, tunnels, Tor, DNS tunnelling), and grades web interface logins, vulnerable versions, filter-list abuse and configuration changes.
summary_zh: 依清單類別（威脅、規避過濾、動態 DNS、rebinding、常被濫用的頂級網域、新註冊網域、廣告）分級 AdGuard Home 的封鎖，回報每個用戶端第一次查詢威脅或規避網域，可選擇分級放行的查詢（OAST 回呼、挖礦礦池、通道服務、Tor、DNS 通道），並分級網頁介面登入、有漏洞的版本、過濾清單濫用與設定變更。
notes: This pack is the attribution layer for DNS detections. A recursive resolver or a firewall only sees the resolver's own address as the query source; AdGuard Home sits in front of the clients, so its log is the only place that records which host asked for a domain.

Query events arrive by syslog with the program name adguard, one JSON object per message, carrying IP, QH, QT, action, filterlist_id, filterlist_name and filtertext. AdGuard Home's own querylog.json has only a numeric list ID, so a log shipper has to add the list name (setup guide). The decoder adds srcip (client), dns.query (domain) and data (domain, for first-time tracking), so other rules and CDB lookups can use them: a lookup on srcip with address_match_key and on dns.query with match_key both work. Allowed queries are optional (1.4): they end at a level 0 base and only feed the allowed-query rules described below.

Grading by list. Threat lists (malware, phishing, badware, scam, C2, cryptomining): the first lookup of a listed domain by a client is level 12 (130913), a repeat is level 7 (130901), a match that came only from a whole-TLD or pattern rule such as ||*.top^ is level 5 (130903), three different first-time threat domains from one client in 10 minutes is level 13 (130914). AdGuard's own safe browsing (list ID -4) is level 10 (130915). Ads, trackers, parental control and blocked services stay at level 2 and do not alert.

Bypass lists (encrypted DNS, VPN, Tor, proxy): the first attempt of a client at an endpoint is level 6 (130905), repeats are recorded at level 2 without an alert (130902, level 3 until 1.2), 20 attempts in 10 minutes from one client is level 10 (130912), which counts those level 2 repeats. Apple iCloud Private Relay and Google tunnel probes are level 2 (130904): blocking those names is how a network opts out, and the device then uses the local resolver, so the block is the device complying, not evading.

Other Security lists of AdGuard's catalogue (1.4) are graded like the bypass lists, a quiet level 2 record for every block and one alert per client and domain: HaGeZi's DynDNS Blocklist level 5 (130951), HaGeZi's DNS Rebind Protection level 5 (130953; services such as plex.direct resolve public names to private addresses on purpose), HaGeZi's The World's Most Abused TLDs level 3 (130955), lists of newly registered domains (NRD) level 5 (130957). URL shortener lists stay at level 2. Nothing fires until a site subscribes to such a list.

Measured on one site over 10.5 days: 7,410 bypass events, of which 3,819 (52 per cent) were relay probes and 3,591 public resolver endpoints (dns.google, cloudflare-dns.com and others), plus 5 threat-list events, all from a ||*.top^ rule. Version 1.1 raised about 700 level 3 alerts a day. On the same events 1.3 alerts on none of the about 336 repeats a day (1.2: level 3), 59 first-time level 6 alerts in total (19 on the first day, none after the seventh), about one level 10 burst a day, and level 5 for the five TLD-wide matches.

Allowed queries (1.4, optional). When the shipper forwards them too, they end at the level 0 base 130916: not alerted and not kept in the correlation memory (about 380,000 a day at the measured site). The rules under it grade what is not routine: an out-of-band interaction (OAST) callback name such as <id>.oast.fun or <id>.oastify.com level 12 (130922: a blind injection that worked, or a security test); a mining pool level 10 the first time per client and name, 5 after (130924, 130923); a NULL query level 8 (130920, the iodine default), a zone transfer level 6 (130921), an ANY query level 5 (130925), NULL and ANY at most every 5 minutes; a .onion or tor2web name level 8 the first time (130961); a base64-padded label level 8 (130964); ten names with a label of 50 or more characters from one client in 5 minutes level 10 (130963); the first lookup of a reverse tunnel service (Cloudflare tunnels, ngrok, VS Code dev tunnels, localtunnel) level 6 (130959); the first Telegram Bot API lookup by a client level 5 (130966); the first lookup of an external IP address service level 3 (130968). Repeats of the first-time ones are level 0. The domain lists follow SigmaHQ, Splunk and the vendors' documentation and live in the rules, so nothing needs a site list. On the measured site's 7 days of allowed queries (2.67 million, 90 clients) this gives about 11 alerts in the first week (one Telegram bot, ten IP lookup pairs), then about none.

A query from a public IPv4 address (130918 blocked, 130917 allowed) is level 6, at most once a day each: the resolver is reachable from the internet and can be used for reflection attacks. IPv6 clients are not graded, because LAN hosts with global IPv6 addresses look exactly like internet clients. The measured site had no public client.

First time seen is Wazuh's fts store, keyed on client address and domain and kept on disk by the node that decodes the event. After installing, expect one burst of first-time alerts for the clients and endpoints already active (59 at the measured site), then a few a day. A client that changes address counts as new.

Correlation windows are 10 minutes or less on purpose. analysisd keeps only the last 8,192 events (memory_size) for if_matched_sid; on a manager handling 20,000 alerts an hour that is 10 to 20 minutes, whatever the timeframe says. 1.1's 130912 had a one-hour timeframe and fired exactly as a 10 to 15 minute window predicts.

Built-in rule 1002 takes any message containing words such as error or failed, and 1003 any message over 1025 bytes, before this pack sees it. Until 1.2 a threat-listed domain such as windows-error-fix.example was graded level 2 by 1002 and never alerted. 130908 and 130907 take those events back.

AdGuard Home service log (journald, syslog or a log file, current and older log format): failed web interface login level 5 (130931), lockout by the login rate limiter level 10 (130932, at most one alert per 5 minutes), eight failures in 5 minutes level 10 (130929, only possible with the rate limiter off), no users configured so the interface is open level 10 (130934), rate limiter disabled level 5 (130935), start and stop level 3. The formats were written from the AdGuard Home source (v0.107.43 to v0.107.79); the measured site does not collect this log yet.

Service log, since 1.4: a version before v0.107.73 at start level 10 (130945, CVE-2026-32136: the whole web API without logging in), v0.107.73 to v0.107.78 level 5 (130946, later fixes missing); a local file refused as a filter list level 10 (130947, a CVE-2024-36814 attempt; only fixed versions log it, vulnerable ones read the file silently); a filter list removed level 5 (130948); the pprof debug server enabled level 5 (130949); a filter list that cannot be updated level 4, at most once an hour (130970); the built-in updater starting level 3 (130972) and failing level 5 (130973). API errors other than the login carry the client as raddr=IP:port and the path as request_uri=; until 1.3 the decoder read neither. The version thresholds are product facts from AdGuard's CHANGELOG and advisories and are raised in pack updates.

A successful login is not an alert by itself (130933, level 2). AdGuard Home has no roles and no built-in account name, so every web user can change all filtering, and what alerts is what is not routine: the first login of a user from a private address, level 3 (130942, first time seen on user and address, so a polling client produces one alert per address, ever); any login from a public address, level 8 every time (130941); success after three or more failures from the same address, level 10 (130939); success from an address the rate limiter had locked out, level 12 (130944). Private means 10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16, 127/8, 100.64/10, fc00::/7 and fe80::/10; an address written ::ffff:a.b.c.d is graded as IPv4.

Logins over IPv6 loopback (::1) are level 2 (130943) and never first-time: Wazuh 4.14.7 matches every IPv4 address against ::1 in any spelling, positive or negated, so ::1 is tested on the raw address field instead of srcip. Built-in 10100 (first login), 40101 (system account names) and 40112 (failures then success) load before this pack and never attach to its rules; jt-ioc's 906050 loads after and does, so a login from a threat-listed address still reaches level 14 when that pack is installed.

AdGuard Home does not log setting changes. The agent group adguard watches AdGuardHome.yaml with file integrity monitoring, and 130940 (level 8) names the change. Verified with real file changes, including the write-then-rename that AdGuard uses. Do not turn on report_changes for it: the file holds the web users' password hashes. Since 1.4 the group also watches the AdGuardHome program file (130974, level 8; CVE-2024-36586: on some installs an unprivileged user can replace the binary that runs as root). A change within 15 minutes of the built-in updater's start on the same host is level 3 (130975).

Changes to existing rules in 1.2: 130901 and 130902 now require action Blocked (an allow-list match inside a threat list no longer alerts), 130901 drops the [WARN] prefix (it is level 7) and its pattern now also covers badware, phishing variants, fraud, hacked sites and coin mining (HaGeZi's Badware Hoster list was not graded before), 130902 refuses a list name that also reads as a threat list, 130912 goes from level 5 with a one-hour window to level 10 with 10 minutes. The decoder's program name is anchored: unanchored, adguard also matched AdGuardHome.

Changes in 1.3 (login policy, no site data): 130933 successful login 3 -> 2; new 130941 public source (8), 130942 first login of a user from an address (3), 130943 IPv6 loopback (2), 130944 success after a lockout (12); 130902 repeat bypass attempt 3 -> 2 (the default stays quiet, 130912 still counts the repeats). The service-log decoders gained first-time tracking and strip ::ffff:; the log-file decoder is now named adguard-home-log. The pack ships no lists, and nothing in it names a host, address or account of a site.

Changes in 1.4: HaGeZi's The World's Most Abused TLDs is no longer graded as a threat list (the word Abused matched the threat pattern, so every block from it was level 5 to 12; now 3 the first time per client and domain, 2 after); 130910 (high volume of filtered lookups) counts 100 blocked events in 2 minutes instead of 40 (measured: 2-minute windows with 40 or more ad blocks from one client, 51 in 7 days; 100 or more, 2) and is no longer triggered by an allowed query; 130925 is ANY only (NULL is 130920 at level 8, zone transfers 130921 at 6) and sits under the allowed base; the service-log decoder reads raddr= and request_uri=; MITRE ids added to 130905 (T1090.003) and 130935 (T1562.001). The pack still ships no lists and names no host, address or account of a site.

Deliberately not done: DNS rebinding judged from the answer (the answer is a base64 DNS message, and at the measured site a third of all answers are the site's own internal names, so it would need site data; the DNS Rebind Protection list is the generic way), NXDOMAIN storms (DGA) and rewritten answers (the shipper would have to decode the answer and the reason), remote access software domains (relay names change, about 44 new client and name pairs a week at the measured site: too noisy without a per-client category), alerting on every newly observed domain (1,500 to 2,900 a day), reading querylog.json directly with the agent (no list names, about 380,000 queries a day), and blocking clients from query events (see active responses).
PREREQUISITE: AdGuard must sit in front of the clients. If clients query a resolver that then forwards to AdGuard, every event carries the resolver's address and attribution is lost.

Verified on Wazuh 4.14.7 in an isolated manager: 149 logtest cases (every new rule with a near miss), plus first-time tracking (queries and logins), the 5-minute alert suppression and the configuration file rule checked with real events; 1.4's program-file rules checked with real file changes (a changed binary is 130974, the same change right after the updater's start line is 130975, files outside the restrict pattern and in data/ raise nothing).

Cross-pack login groups (patch release): jt_auth_success on 130933, 130941, 130942, 130943; jt_auth_failure on 130931; jt_auth_lockout on 130932. They let jt-account-guard correlate logins across services and jt-ioc look up the address of every tagged successful login; levels and matching are unchanged, and without those packs the groups do nothing. The failed login line names no account, so 130931 only serves the address-based correlations.
notes_zh: 本套組是 DNS 偵測的溯源層。遞迴解析器或防火牆只看得到解析器自己的位址；AdGuard Home 位於用戶端前方，它的記錄是唯一記下「哪一台主機查詢了某網域」的地方。

查詢事件以 syslog 送達，program name 為 adguard，每則訊息一個 JSON 物件，含 IP、QH、QT、action、filterlist_id、filterlist_name、filtertext。AdGuard Home 自己的 querylog.json 只有數字清單 ID，因此需要記錄轉送程式補上清單名稱（見部署說明）。解碼器另外產生 srcip（用戶端）、dns.query（網域）與 data（網域，供首次出現判斷），其他規則與 CDB 清單可直接使用：srcip 以 address_match_key、dns.query 以 match_key 查詢皆已驗證。放行的查詢為選用（1.4）：它們停在 level 0 的基礎規則，只供下面說明的放行查詢規則使用。

依清單分級。威脅清單（惡意程式、釣魚、badware、詐騙、C2、挖礦）：某用戶端第一次查詢清單上的網域為 level 12（130913），重複查詢為 level 7（130901），只被整個頂級網域或樣式規則（例如 ||*.top^）擋下的為 level 5（130903），同一用戶端 10 分鐘內有三個不同的首次威脅網域為 level 13（130914）。AdGuard 自己的安全瀏覽（清單 ID -4）為 level 10（130915）。廣告、追蹤、家長監護與封鎖服務停在 level 2，不告警。

規避清單（加密 DNS、VPN、Tor、代理）：用戶端第一次嘗試某個端點為 level 6（130905），之後重複以 level 2 記錄、不告警（130902，1.2 之前為 level 3），同一用戶端 10 分鐘內 20 次為 level 10（130912），計算的正是這些 level 2 重複。Apple iCloud 私密轉送與 Google tunnel 的探測為 level 2（130904）：擋下這些名稱正是網路管理者關閉它們的方式，裝置隨即改用本地解析器，所以這是裝置配合，不是規避。

AdGuard 清單目錄中其他的安全類清單（1.4）分級方式與規避清單相同：每次封鎖以 level 2 安靜記錄，每個用戶端與網域只告警一次：HaGeZi's DynDNS Blocklist 為 level 5（130951）、HaGeZi's DNS Rebind Protection 為 level 5（130953；plex.direct 等服務本來就會把公開名稱解析成私有位址）、HaGeZi's The World's Most Abused TLDs 為 level 3（130955）、新註冊網域（NRD）清單為 level 5（130957）。短網址清單維持 level 2。站台未訂閱這些清單之前不會觸發。

單一站台 10.5 天實測：規避事件 7,410 筆，其中 3,819 筆（52%）是轉送探測、3,591 筆是公共解析器端點（dns.google、cloudflare-dns.com 等）；威脅清單事件 5 筆，全部來自 ||*.top^ 規則。1.1 版每天約 700 筆 level 3 告警。同一批事件在 1.3 版，每天約 336 筆重複都不告警（1.2 為 level 3）、首次 level 6 共 59 筆（第一天 19 筆，第七天之後沒有）、每天約一次 level 10 連續嘗試，五筆整個頂級網域的比對為 level 5。

放行的查詢（1.4，選用）。轉送程式也送出放行的查詢時，它們會停在 level 0 的基礎規則 130916：不告警，也不佔用關聯記憶（實測站台每天約 38 萬筆）。其下的規則只分級不尋常的部分：帶外互動（OAST）回呼名稱，例如 <id>.oast.fun 或 <id>.oastify.com 為 level 12（130922：盲注入成功，或是安全測試）；挖礦礦池每個用戶端與名稱第一次為 level 10、之後為 5（130924、130923）；NULL 查詢 level 8（130920，iodine 的預設）、區域轉送 level 6（130921）、ANY 查詢 level 5（130925），NULL 與 ANY 每 5 分鐘最多告警一次；.onion 或 tor2web 名稱第一次為 level 8（130961）；帶 base64 補位的標籤 level 8（130964）；同一用戶端 5 分鐘內10 個含 50 字元以上標籤的名稱 level 10（130963）；第一次查詢反向通道服務（Cloudflare tunnel、ngrok、VS Code dev tunnels、localtunnel）level 6（130959）；用戶端第一次查詢 Telegram Bot API level 5（130966）；第一次查詢外部 IP 查詢服務 level 3（130968）。首次類規則的重複查詢為 level 0。網域清單依 SigmaHQ、Splunk 與各廠商文件整理，直接寫在規則裡，不需要任何站台清單。以實測站台 7 天的放行查詢（267 萬筆、90 個用戶端）估算，第一週約 11 則告警（一個 Telegram 機器人、十組 IP 查詢），之後幾乎沒有。
來自公網 IPv4 位址的查詢（130918 封鎖、130917 放行）為 level 6，各自每天最多一次：表示解析器可從網際網路連到，可能被用於反射攻擊。IPv6 用戶端不做此判斷，因為使用全域 IPv6 位址的區網主機看起來與網際網路用戶端完全相同。實測站台沒有任何公網用戶端。
「首次出現」使用 Wazuh 的 fts 儲存，以用戶端位址加網域為鍵，由解碼該事件的節點存在磁碟上。安裝後會先出現一波目前已在活動的用戶端與端點的首次告警（實測站台為 59 筆），之後每天幾筆。用戶端換了位址會被當成新的。
關聯時間窗刻意不超過 10 分鐘。analysisd 只為 if_matched_sid 保留最後 8,192 筆事件（memory_size）；在每小時兩萬筆告警的 manager 上那只有 10 到 20 分鐘，不論 timeframe 寫多少。1.1 的 130912 寫一小時，實際觸發情形與 10 到 15 分鐘的時間窗完全吻合。
內建規則 1002 會先拿走含有 error、failed 等字的訊息，1003 會拿走超過 1025 位元組的訊息。1.2 之前，像 windows-error-fix.example 這種威脅網域會被 1002 判成 level 2，永遠不告警。130908 與 130907 會把這些事件接回來。

AdGuard Home 服務記錄（journald、syslog 或記錄檔，新舊兩種格式皆支援）：網頁介面登入失敗 level 5（130931）、被登入速率限制鎖住 level 10（130932，每 5 分鐘最多一則）、5 分鐘內失敗 8 次 level 10（130929，只有關閉速率限制時才可能）、沒有設定任何使用者因此介面完全開放 level 10（130934）、速率限制被關閉 level 5（130935）、啟動與停止 level 3。這些格式依 AdGuard Home 原始碼（v0.107.43 到 v0.107.79）撰寫；實測站台目前尚未收集這份記錄。

服務記錄，1.4 起另有：啟動時版本早於 v0.107.73 為 level 10（130945，CVE-2026-32136：免登入即可使用整個網頁 API），v0.107.73 到 v0.107.78 為 level 5（130946，缺少之後的修正）；拒絕把本機檔案當成過濾清單 level 10（130947，CVE-2024-36814 的嘗試；只有已修正的版本會記錄，有漏洞的版本會默默讀出檔案）；移除過濾清單 level 5（130948）；啟用 pprof 除錯伺服器 level 5（130949）；過濾清單無法更新 level 4，每小時最多一次（130970）；內建更新程式開始更新 level 3（130972）、更新失敗 level 5（130973）。登入以外的 API 錯誤以 raddr=IP:埠 記錄用戶端、以 request_uri= 記錄路徑；1.3 之前解碼器兩者都沒讀。版本門檻是取自 AdGuard CHANGELOG 與安全公告的產品事實，會隨套件更新調高。

成功登入本身不是告警（130933，level 2）。AdGuard Home 沒有角色、也沒有內建帳號名稱，每個網頁使用者都能改動全部過濾設定，所以告警的是「不尋常」的部分：某使用者第一次從某個私有位址登入 level 3（130942，以使用者加位址做首次出現判斷，輪詢的用戶端每個位址永遠只告警一次）；任何來自公網位址的登入每次都是 level 8（130941）；同一位址失敗三次以上後成功 level 10（130939）；被速率限制鎖過的位址登入成功 level 12（130944）。私有位址指 10/8、172.16/12、192.168/16、127/8、100.64/10、fc00::/7、fe80::/10；寫成 ::ffff:a.b.c.d 的位址當成 IPv4 判斷。

經 IPv6 loopback（::1）的登入為 level 2（130943），也不做首次出現判斷：Wazuh 4.14.7 不論正向或反向、任何寫法，都會把每個 IPv4 位址比對成 ::1，所以 ::1 改用原始位址欄位判斷，不用 srcip。內建 10100（首次登入）、40101（系統帳號名稱）與 40112（失敗後成功）比本套件先載入，不會掛到本套件的規則上；jt-ioc 的 906050 較晚載入，會掛上，所以安裝該套件時，來自威脅清單位址的登入仍會到 level 14。

AdGuard Home 不記錄設定變更。agent 群組 adguard 以檔案完整性監控盯住 AdGuardHome.yaml，由 130940（level 8）指出變更。已用真實檔案變更驗證，包括 AdGuard 使用的先寫暫存檔再改名。不要對它開啟 report_changes：這個檔案含有網頁使用者的密碼雜湊。1.4 起群組也監控 AdGuardHome 程式檔（130974，level 8；CVE-2024-36586：部分安裝方式下，非特權使用者可以替換以 root 執行的程式檔）。同一台主機上內建更新程式開始後 15 分鐘內的變更為 level 3（130975）。

1.2 對既有規則的變更：130901 與 130902 現在要求 action 為 Blocked（威脅清單內的放行規則不再告警）；130901 拿掉 [WARN] 前綴（它是 level 7），比對樣式加上 badware、釣魚的各種寫法、詐騙、被入侵網站與挖礦（HaGeZi 的 Badware Hoster 清單先前不會被分級）；130902 不接受同時讀起來像威脅清單的名稱；130912 由 level 5、一小時時間窗改為 level 10、10 分鐘。解碼器的 program name 改為完整比對：不加錨點時 adguard 也會比對到 AdGuardHome。

1.3 的變更（登入政策、不依賴站台資料）：130933 成功登入 3 -> 2；新增 130941 公網來源（8）、130942 使用者首次從某位址登入（3）、130943 IPv6 loopback（2）、130944 被鎖定後成功（12）；130902 重複的規避嘗試 3 -> 2（預設維持安靜，130912 仍計算這些重複）。服務記錄解碼器加上首次出現判斷並去除 ::ffff:；記錄檔解碼器改名為 adguard-home-log。本套件不附任何清單，內容也不指名任何站台的主機、位址或帳號。

1.4 的變更：HaGeZi's The World's Most Abused TLDs 不再被當成威脅清單（Abused 這個字會比中威脅樣式，所以它的每次封鎖都是 level 5 到 12；現在每個用戶端與網域第一次為 3、之後為 2）；130910（大量被過濾的查詢）改為 2 分鐘內 100 筆封鎖事件，原為 40（實測同一用戶端 2 分鐘內 40 筆以上廣告封鎖的時段 7 天有 51 個，100 筆以上有 2 個），且不再由放行的查詢觸發；130925 只看 ANY（NULL 為 130920，level 8；區域轉送為 130921，level 6），並移到放行查詢的基礎規則之下；服務記錄解碼器讀取 raddr= 與 request_uri=；130905 加上 MITRE T1090.003、130935 加上 T1562.001。本套件仍不附任何清單，也不指名任何站台的主機、位址或帳號。

刻意不做：依回應內容判斷 DNS rebinding（回應是 base64 的 DNS 訊息，而且實測站台三分之一的回應是站台自己的內部名稱，需要站台資料；DNS Rebind Protection 清單才是通用的做法）、NXDOMAIN 暴增（DGA）與被改寫的回應（需要轉送程式解出回應內容與原因）、遠端控制軟體網域（中繼名稱會變，實測站台每週約 44 組新的用戶端與名稱組合，沒有以用戶端為單位的分類就太吵）、每個新出現的網域都告警（每天 1,500 到 2,900 個）、以 agent 直接讀 querylog.json（沒有清單名稱，每天約 38 萬筆查詢）、依查詢事件封鎖用戶端（見主動回應說明）。
前提條件：AdGuard 必須位於用戶端前方。若用戶端查詢的是另一台解析器再轉給 AdGuard，每筆事件都只會帶解析器的位址，溯源能力就沒了。
已在隔離的 Wazuh 4.14.7 manager 上驗證：149 個 logtest 情境（每條新規則都有對應的不該命中案例），另以真實事件驗證首次出現判斷（查詢與登入）、5 分鐘告警抑制與設定檔規則；1.4 的程式檔規則以真實檔案變更驗證（程式檔變更為 130974，在更新程式的啟動訊息之後的同樣變更為 130975，restrict 樣式以外的檔案與 data/ 內的檔案都沒有告警）。

跨套件登入群組（修補版）：jt_auth_success：130933, 130941, 130942, 130943；jt_auth_failure：130931；jt_auth_lockout：130932。讓 jt-account-guard 跨服務關聯登入、jt-ioc 查詢每一筆加標記的成功登入來源位址；等級與比對條件不變，沒有安裝這些套件時群組沒有作用。登入失敗那行沒有帳號，所以 130931 只用於以來源位址關聯的規則。
author: Jason Tools

agent_group.name: adguard
agent_group.description: The AdGuard Home host: file integrity monitoring of AdGuardHome.yaml, since AdGuard does not log setting changes

setup.title: Install the pack and reload the ruleset on every node
setup.title_zh: 安裝套件並在所有節點重新載入規則集
setup.body: Install from this page, then use Reload Ruleset on the Rules tab. A cluster synchronises rule files but does not reload the workers. Expect one burst of first-time alerts (levels 6 and 12) for the clients already active, then a few a day.
setup.body_zh: 在本頁安裝後，到「規則」分頁按「重新載入規則集」。叢集只同步規則檔、不會重載 worker。安裝後會先出現一波目前已在活動之用戶端的首次告警（level 6 與 12），之後每天幾筆。

setup.title: Forward blocked queries by syslog, with the list name
setup.title_zh: 以 syslog 轉送被擋下的查詢，並附上清單名稱
setup.body: Run a log shipper (for example Vector or Fluent Bit) on the AdGuard host that reads querylog.json and sends one JSON object per syslog message with the program name adguard to the manager's syslog port. Fields: IP, QH, QT, Elapsed, Upstream, action (Blocked or Allowed), filterlist_id, filterlist_name and filtertext, taken from Result.Rules[0] with the name looked up from the filters section of AdGuardHome.yaml by ID. Sending only blocked queries is enough (about 5 per cent of all queries at the measured site), and ads and tracker lists may be left out. Allowed queries are optional (next step). Allow the AdGuard host in the manager's syslog <remote> block. Nothing on AdGuard itself changes.
setup.body_zh: 在 AdGuard 主機上執行記錄轉送程式（例如 Vector 或 Fluent Bit），讀取 querylog.json，每則 syslog 訊息送一個 JSON 物件到 manager 的 syslog 連接埠，program name 為 adguard。欄位：IP、QH、QT、Elapsed、Upstream、action（Blocked 或 Allowed）、filterlist_id、filterlist_name、filtertext，取自 Result.Rules[0]，清單名稱依 ID 從 AdGuardHome.yaml 的 filters 區段查出。只送被擋下的查詢就夠了（實測站台約佔全部查詢的 5%），廣告與追蹤清單也可以不送。放行的查詢為選用（見下一步）。並在 manager syslog 的 <remote> 允許 AdGuard 主機。AdGuard 本身不需任何變更。
setup.verify: On the manager: tcpdump -n -A -i any udp port <syslog port> and host <AdGuard host> shows lines like the example; a lookup of dns.google from a client raises 130905.
setup.verify_zh: 在 manager 上執行 tcpdump -n -A -i any udp port <syslog 連接埠> and host <AdGuard 主機>，應看到與範例相同的行；從用戶端查詢 dns.google 會觸發 130905。

setup.title: Optional: forward allowed queries too
setup.title_zh: 選用：也轉送放行的查詢
setup.body: Sending allowed queries as well lights up the allowed-query rules: OAST callbacks, mining pools, reverse tunnels, Tor, DNS tunnelling (NULL queries, long or base64 labels), zone transfer and ANY queries, the Telegram Bot API, IP lookup services and public clients. Use the same message shape with action Allowed; the filterlist fields may be left out. An allowed query that no rule claims ends at level 0 (130916), so it is neither alerted nor kept in the correlation memory: the cost is syslog traffic and decoding, about 4.4 events a second at the measured site (380,000 a day). If the manager archives every event (logall), the archives grow by the same amount. Nothing changes on AdGuard itself.
setup.body_zh: 也送出放行的查詢，就能啟用放行查詢的規則：OAST 回呼、挖礦礦池、反向通道服務、Tor、DNS 通道（NULL 查詢、過長或 base64 的標籤）、區域轉送與 ANY 查詢、Telegram Bot API、IP 查詢服務與公網用戶端。訊息格式相同，action 為 Allowed，清單欄位可省略。沒有任何規則接走的放行查詢會停在 level 0（130916），不告警也不佔用關聯記憶：成本只有 syslog 流量與解碼，實測站台約每秒 4.4 筆（每天 38 萬筆）。若 manager 記錄全部事件（logall），archives 會增加同樣的量。AdGuard 本身不需任何變更。
setup.verify: Look up api.ipify.org once from a client: 130968 (level 3) appears; later lookups from that client and ordinary lookups raise nothing.
setup.verify_zh: 從一台用戶端查詢一次 api.ipify.org：出現 130968（level 3）；同一台之後的查詢與一般查詢都不會有告警。

setup.title: Optional: subscribe to more Security lists
setup.title_zh: 選用：訂閱更多安全類清單
setup.body: In AdGuard Home under Filters, DNS blocklists, Add blocklist, Choose from the list, Security: HaGeZi's DynDNS Blocklist, HaGeZi's DNS Rebind Protection and HaGeZi's The World's Most Abused TLDs are graded by this pack (130951, 130953, 130955), and so are lists of newly registered domains added by URL with NRD or Newly Registered in their name (130957). Keep the names AdGuard proposes: the rules grade by list name. These lists block real traffic: Most Abused TLDs blocks whole TLDs, and DNS Rebind Protection blocks public names that resolve to private addresses (if the site's public DNS points to internal addresses, add an allow rule for them first).
setup.body_zh: 在 AdGuard Home 的「過濾器 > DNS 封鎖清單 > 新增封鎖清單 > 從清單選擇」的 Security 群組中，HaGeZi's DynDNS Blocklist、HaGeZi's DNS Rebind Protection 與 HaGeZi's The World's Most Abused TLDs 會由本套件分級（130951、130953、130955）；以網址加入、名稱含 NRD 或 Newly Registered 的新註冊網域清單也會分級（130957）。請保留 AdGuard 預設的清單名稱：規則依清單名稱分級。這些清單會擋下真實流量：Most Abused TLDs 會擋掉整個頂級網域，DNS Rebind Protection 會擋掉解析到私有位址的公開名稱（若站台的公開 DNS 指向內部位址，請先為它們加上放行規則）。

setup.title: Put AdGuard in front of the clients
setup.title_zh: 讓 AdGuard 直接面對用戶端
setup.body: Clients must query AdGuard directly (DHCP hands out its address). If they query another resolver that forwards to AdGuard, every event carries that resolver's address and a lookup can no longer be traced to a host.
setup.body_zh: 用戶端必須直接查詢 AdGuard（由 DHCP 發放它的位址）。若用戶端先查另一台解析器再轉給 AdGuard，每筆事件都只會是那台解析器的位址，無法追到發出查詢的主機。

setup.title: Assign the AdGuard host to the adguard group
setup.title_zh: 把 AdGuard 主機加入 adguard 群組
setup.body: The group watches AdGuardHome.yaml and, since 1.4, the AdGuardHome program file in /opt/AdGuardHome, the official install location; for a snap or Docker install add the configuration path in the group file. Only these two files are watched, not the query log next to them. The agent applies a new group configuration when it restarts; AdGuard Home is not touched.
setup.body_zh: 群組會監控 /opt/AdGuardHome（官方安裝程式的位置）中的 AdGuardHome.yaml，1.4 起也監控 AdGuardHome 程式檔；snap 或 Docker 安裝請在群組檔加上設定檔的路徑。只監控這兩個檔案，不含旁邊的查詢記錄。agent 重新啟動後才會套用新的群組設定；AdGuard Home 不受影響。
setup.verify: Change any setting in the AdGuard web interface: 130940 appears within seconds.
setup.verify_zh: 在 AdGuard 網頁介面改任一設定：數秒內出現 130940。

setup.title: Restart the agents of the adguard group to watch the program file
setup.title_zh: 重新啟動 adguard 群組的 agent 以監控程式檔
setup.body: The 1.4 group file also watches the AdGuardHome program file in /opt/AdGuardHome (130974, 130975). The agents receive the new group file by themselves but apply file integrity settings only when they restart. AdGuard Home is not touched.
setup.body_zh: 1.4 的群組檔也監控 /opt/AdGuardHome 中的 AdGuardHome 程式檔（130974、130975）。agent 會自動收到新的群組檔，但檔案完整性設定要重新啟動後才會套用。AdGuard Home 不受影響。
setup.verify: After the restart and its first scan, the agent's file integrity inventory lists /opt/AdGuardHome/AdGuardHome (dashboard: File Integrity Monitoring, or GET /syscheck/<agent id>?file=/opt/AdGuardHome/AdGuardHome). The next update from the web interface raises 130972 and then 130975 (level 3).
setup.verify_zh: 重新啟動並完成第一次掃描後，該 agent 的檔案完整性清單會列出 /opt/AdGuardHome/AdGuardHome（儀表板的 File Integrity Monitoring，或 GET /syscheck/<agent id>?file=/opt/AdGuardHome/AdGuardHome）。之後從網頁介面更新會先出現 130972，再出現 130975（level 3）。

setup.title: Make sure the AdGuard Home service log reaches Wazuh
setup.title_zh: 確認 AdGuard Home 服務記錄有送進 Wazuh
setup.body: Logins and authentication settings come from AdGuard Home's own log, not the query log. Run as a systemd service, it logs to journald, which the Wazuh agent on that host reads by default: nothing to do. If log.file in AdGuardHome.yaml points to a file, add a localfile with log_format syslog for that file to the agent. If it is syslog, forward that program (AdGuardHome) to the manager.
setup.body_zh: 登入與驗證設定來自 AdGuard Home 自己的記錄，不是查詢記錄。以 systemd 服務執行時它寫入 journald，該主機上的 Wazuh agent 預設就會讀取，不需動作。若 AdGuardHome.yaml 的 log.file 指向檔案，請在 agent 加一個 log_format 為 syslog 的 localfile 讀取該檔。若設為 syslog，請把該程式（AdGuardHome）的訊息轉送到 manager。
setup.verify: Log in to the AdGuard web interface with a wrong password once: 130931 appears. Then log in correctly: 130942 appears the first time, later logins from the same address stay at level 2.
setup.verify_zh: 在 AdGuard 網頁介面用錯誤密碼登入一次：出現 130931。接著正確登入：第一次出現 130942，之後從同一位址登入維持 level 2。

setup.title: Run AdGuard Home v0.107.79 or later
setup.title_zh: 執行 AdGuard Home v0.107.79 或更新版本
setup.body: 130945 (level 10) fires when AdGuard Home starts a version before v0.107.73: CVE-2026-32136 lets anyone who reaches the web interface use the whole API without logging in. 130946 (level 5) fires for v0.107.73 to v0.107.78, which miss later fixes. The version comes from the start line of the service log, so it needs that log in Wazuh (previous step). Update from the web interface (the update notice at the top) or rerun the official install script; either restarts AdGuard Home, a few seconds without DNS. An update from the web interface also changes the program file: 130975 (level 3) instead of 130974.
setup.body_zh: AdGuard Home 啟動的版本早於 v0.107.73 時觸發 130945（level 10）：CVE-2026-32136 讓任何連得到網頁介面的人不必登入就能使用整個 API。v0.107.73 到 v0.107.78 觸發 130946（level 5），缺少之後的修正。版本取自服務記錄的啟動訊息，因此需要那份記錄進入 Wazuh（上一步）。從網頁介面（頂端的更新通知）更新，或重新執行官方安裝程式；兩者都會重新啟動 AdGuard Home，期間會有幾秒沒有 DNS。從網頁介面更新也會改動程式檔：此時為 130975（level 3），而不是 130974。
setup.verify: After the update the start line raises only 130936 (level 3).
setup.verify_zh: 更新後啟動訊息只會觸發 130936（level 3）。

setup.title: Behind a reverse proxy, let AdGuard log the client address
setup.title_zh: 位於反向代理後方時，讓 AdGuard 記下用戶端位址
setup.body: AdGuard Home logs the proxy's address for web logins unless the proxy is listed in dns.trusted_proxies in AdGuardHome.yaml (default: 127.0.0.0/8 and ::1, so a proxy on the same host already works); then it logs the client address from the forwarding headers. Without it every login appears to come from the proxy, so the public-source rule (130941) and first-time tracking see one address. The change takes effect when AdGuard Home restarts, a few seconds without DNS.
setup.body_zh: 除非反向代理列在 AdGuardHome.yaml 的 dns.trusted_proxies（預設 127.0.0.0/8 與 ::1，所以同一台主機上的代理本來就可以），AdGuard Home 記錄網頁登入時寫的是代理的位址；列入後才會從轉送標頭記下用戶端位址。沒有設定時所有登入都像是來自代理，公網來源規則（130941）與首次出現判斷只會看到一個位址。修改在 AdGuard Home 重新啟動後生效，期間會有幾秒沒有 DNS。

setup.title: Keep the web interface protected
setup.title_zh: 確保網頁介面受到保護
setup.body: AdGuard Home disables authentication when no users are configured (130934) and disables its login rate limiter when auth_attempts or block_auth_min is 0 (130935). Keep at least one user and the defaults (5 attempts, 15 minutes): the lockout rule 130932 depends on them.
setup.body_zh: AdGuard Home 在沒有設定任何使用者時會關閉驗證（130934），auth_attempts 或 block_auth_min 為 0 時會關閉登入速率限制（130935）。請至少保留一個使用者並維持預設值（5 次、15 分鐘）：鎖定規則 130932 依賴這兩項設定。

active_response.title: Block an address that keeps guessing the AdGuard web interface password
active_response.title_zh: 封鎖一再猜測 AdGuard 網頁介面密碼的位址
active_response.body: Drops all traffic from the source address on the AdGuard host (set the defined agent to it) for 15 minutes after a rate-limiter lockout (130932) or eight failures in five minutes (130929). Risks: the firewall drop covers DNS too, so a blocked client also loses name resolution for 15 minutes; an administrator who mistypes is locked out of DNS and the interface; if the interface sits behind a reverse proxy, the source is the proxy and every user is blocked. AdGuard already refuses the address at the web layer for 15 minutes, so this adds little while its rate limiter is on. 130932 alerts at most once per 5 minutes, so a second address in that window is not blocked. Put management addresses in the manager's white_list first. Never attach a response to the query rules: blocking a LAN client cuts its DNS, and a compromised host simply switches to hard-coded resolvers.
active_response.body_zh: 速率限制鎖定（130932）或 5 分鐘內失敗 8 次（130929）後，在 AdGuard 主機（defined agent 請設為它）上封鎖來源位址的所有流量 15 分鐘。風險：防火牆封鎖也包含 DNS，被封鎖的用戶端 15 分鐘內無法解析名稱；打錯密碼的管理者會同時失去 DNS 與介面；若介面位於反向代理後方，來源就是代理，所有使用者都會被封鎖。AdGuard 本身已在網頁層拒絕該位址 15 分鐘，速率限制開啟時這個回應的效益有限。130932 每 5 分鐘最多告警一次，同一時段內第二個位址不會被封鎖。請先把管理位址加入 manager 的 white_list。不要對查詢類規則掛主動回應：封鎖區網用戶端等於切斷它的 DNS，而被入侵的主機只會改用寫死的解析器。
